import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, adjusted_rand_score
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# 1. Load and filter data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Keep only the three sites of interest
sites = [
    'Skin',
    'Lymph nodes',
    'Connective, subcutaneous and other soft tissues'
]
clin3 = clin[clin['primary_site'].isin(sites)].copy()
# Map samples to patients and merge
samples = expr.columns.to_frame(index=False, name='sample')
samples['patient'] = samples['sample'].str[:12]
samples = samples.merge(
    clin3[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'primary_site']],
    left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner'
)
# 2. Select one sample per patient (first occurrence)
samples = samples.drop_duplicates(subset='patient', keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
expr_filt = expr[samples['sample']]
# 3. Select top 5000 most variable genes
gene_var = expr_filt.var(axis=1)
top5k = gene_var.nlargest(5000).index
dat = expr_filt.loc[top5k].T  # samples x genes
# 4. Standardize per gene
scaler = StandardScaler()
dat_std = scaler.fit_transform(dat)

# 5. Silhouette analysis for k=2,3,4
sil_scores = {}
for k in [2, 3, 4]:
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    lbl = km.fit_predict(dat_std)
    sil_scores[k] = silhouette_score(dat_std, lbl)
# Plot silhouette scores
def plot_silhouette(scores):
    plt.figure(figsize=(5,4))
    ks = list(scores.keys())
    vals = list(scores.values())
    plt.plot(ks, vals, marker='o')
    plt.xlabel('k (number of clusters)')
    plt.ylabel('Silhouette score')
    plt.title('Silhouette Analysis (k=2-4)')
    plt.xticks(ks)
    # Highlight k=3
    plt.scatter(3, scores[3], s=100, facecolors='none', edgecolors='r')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
plot_silhouette(sil_scores)

# 6. Cluster assignment with k=3
def assign_clusters(data, k):
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    return km.fit_predict(data)
samples['cluster'] = assign_clusters(dat_std, 3)

# 7. Contingency table and statistics
tab = pd.crosstab(samples['cluster'], samples['primary_site'])
chi2, pval, _, _ = chi2_contingency(tab)
# Compute ARI
true_codes, _ = pd.factorize(samples['primary_site'])
ari = adjusted_rand_score(true_codes, samples['cluster'])
print('Contingency Table (cluster vs primary_site):')
print(tab)
print(f"Chi-square p-value: {pval:.4e}")
print(f"Adjusted Rand Index: {ari:.3f}\n")

# 8. PCA visualization
def plot_pca(data, meta):
    pca = PCA(n_components=2, random_state=42)
    pcs = pca.fit_transform(data)
    dfp = pd.DataFrame({
        'PC1': pcs[:,0], 'PC2': pcs[:,1],
        'cluster': meta['cluster'].astype(str),
        'primary_site': meta['primary_site']
    })
    plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=dfp, x='PC1', y='PC2',
        hue='cluster', style='primary_site',
        palette='Set1', s=60
    )
    plt.title('PCA of Top 5000 Variable Genes (k=3)')
    plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

plot_pca(dat_std, samples)

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, adjusted_rand_score
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# 1. Load and filter data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Keep only the three sites of interest
sites = [
    'Skin',
    'Lymph nodes',
    'Connective, subcutaneous and other soft tissues'
]
clin3 = clin[clin['primary_site'].isin(sites)].copy()
# Map samples to patients and merge
samples = expr.columns.to_frame(index=False, name='sample')
samples['patient'] = samples['sample'].str[:12]
samples = samples.merge(
    clin3[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'primary_site']],
    left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner'
)
# 2. Select one sample per patient (first occurrence)
samples = samples.drop_duplicates(subset='patient', keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
expr_filt = expr[samples['sample']]
# 3. Select top 5000 most variable genes
gene_var = expr_filt.var(axis=1)
top5k = gene_var.nlargest(5000).index
dat = expr_filt.loc[top5k].T  # samples x genes
# 4. Standardize per gene
scaler = StandardScaler()
dat_std = scaler.fit_transform(dat)

# 5. Silhouette analysis for k=2,3,4
sil_scores = {}
for k in [2, 3, 4]:
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    lbl = km.fit_predict(dat_std)
    sil_scores[k] = silhouette_score(dat_std, lbl)
# Plot silhouette scores
def plot_silhouette(scores):
    plt.figure(figsize=(5,4))
    ks = list(scores.keys())
    vals = list(scores.values())
    plt.plot(ks, vals, marker='o')
    plt.xlabel('k (number of clusters)')
    plt.ylabel('Silhouette score')
    plt.title('Silhouette Analysis (k=2-4)')
    plt.xticks(ks)
    # Highlight k=3
    plt.scatter(3, scores[3], s=100, facecolors='none', edgecolors='r')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
plot_silhouette(sil_scores)

# 6. Cluster assignment with k=3
def assign_clusters(data, k):
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    return km.fit_predict(data)
samples['cluster'] = assign_clusters(dat_std, 3)

# 7. Contingency table and statistics
tab = pd.crosstab(samples['cluster'], samples['primary_site'])
chi2, pval, _, _ = chi2_contingency(tab)
# Compute ARI
true_codes, _ = pd.factorize(samples['primary_site'])
ari = adjusted_rand_score(true_codes, samples['cluster'])
print('Contingency Table (cluster vs primary_site):')
print(tab)
print(f"Chi-square p-value: {pval:.4e}")
print(f"Adjusted Rand Index: {ari:.3f}\n")

# 8. PCA visualization
def plot_pca(data, meta):
    pca = PCA(n_components=2, random_state=42)
    pcs = pca.fit_transform(data)
    dfp = pd.DataFrame({
        'PC1': pcs[:,0], 'PC2': pcs[:,1],
        'cluster': meta['cluster'].astype(str),
        'primary_site': meta['primary_site']
    })
    plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=dfp, x='PC1', y='PC2',
        hue='cluster', style='primary_site',
        palette='Set1', s=60
    )
    plt.title('PCA of Top 5000 Variable Genes (k=3)')
    plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

plot_pca(dat_std, samples)
"}
